# happenin

> A macOS CLI that records Cursor and Claude Code agent events to a local SQLite database and serves a live browser dashboard.

Important notes:

- Development of this repository requires [Nub](https://nubjs.com); end users will be able to install the published package with npm once it ships.
- The CLI exposes `install`, `record`, `import`, `query`, `sessions`, and `dashboard` commands.
- There are zero runtime dependencies; the dashboard loads small client libraries (htmx, htmx-ext-sse) from a CDN.
- `happenin` is pre-1.0. The CLI, database schema, and dashboard output may change in small ways until v1.0.0; breaking changes are noted in the [changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/docs/CHANGELOG.md).

## Implementation

- [src/cli/bin.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/cli/bin.ts): CLI executable entry point.
- [src/cli/index.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/cli/index.ts): CLI dispatch for `install`, `record`, `import`, `query`, `sessions`, `dashboard`, `--help`, and `--version`.
- [src/shared/db.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/shared/db.ts): SQLite data layer.
- [src/cli/record.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/cli/record.ts): Hook target; reads JSON from stdin and stores an event.
- [src/cli/install.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/cli/install.ts): Backs up and appends hooks to Cursor and Claude Code configs.
- [src/cli/import.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/cli/import.ts): Imports Claude and Cursor transcripts.
- [src/UI/dashboard/index.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/UI/dashboard/index.ts): HTTP server, SSE, and routing.
- [src/UI/dashboard/page.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/UI/dashboard/page.ts): Full-page HTML shell and client script for the session overview dashboard.
- [src/UI/dashboard/fragments.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/UI/dashboard/fragments.ts): HTMX fragment rendering and query parsing.
- [src/UI/dashboard/components/*.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/UI/dashboard/components): Header, filters, metric cards, event-frequency SVG chart, tool-usage CSS bars, sessions table, and detail panel.
- [src/shared/constants.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/shared/constants.ts): Hook event lists and default responses.
- [src/shared/types.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/shared/types.ts): Shared TypeScript types.
- [src/cli/query.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/cli/query.ts): Filter and format events for the `query` and `sessions` commands.
- [src/cli/sessions.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/cli/sessions.ts): Session summaries for the `sessions` command.
- [src/shared/view.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YogliB/happenin/main/src/shared/view.ts): Shared event view used by `query` and `dashboard`.
